indicator_name: Bank loans to the economy issued during the month, by borrower's industry (analytical presentation)
description: Кредиты банковского сектора экономике, выданные за месяц, по отраслям заёмщиков (аналитическое представление)
unit: million KZT, issued during the month
methodology: NBK formId=493, one row per cell of industry x purpose x borrower x currency x maturity x region x size x bank/non-bank (111 273 rows, 2023-01 … ); items are sums. INDUSTRY splits into INDUSTRY.MANUFACTURING / .MINING / .OTHER_INDUSTRY; HOUSEHOLDS = loans to individuals (the form leaves their industry «undefined»). Dated by the month the loans were issued: the NBK stamps a month's flow with the 1st of the next month (as form 486, LOAN_RATE_ISSUED_*), shifted here. sources.yaml (2026-08) set 488/493 aside as «microdata with no aggregation field»; the rows are a partition and TOTAL is their sum. Report dates from 2026-05-01 fetched; earlier values kept from the archive.
